pair.human_continuation:
The roof had to be replaced twice due to weather damage, including a 1793 lightning strike and a rainstorm in 1875. Its present eclectic appearance was designed by Miklós Ybl in 1877. 

The church was renovated in 1957-1960 and again in 1997. In the 20th century, religious classrooms were added to the originally 18th-century parish building.

Church interior 

The nave is triple-vaulted and contains an organ gallery. Curved alcoves on either side give the interior an impression of size and space greater than its actual dimensions. Sections of the walls "retract" into the space to absorb the horizontal forces of the arches.

The murals were painted in the 1920s.

Artwork 

The painting on the main altar is the Visitation of the Virgin Mary to Saint Elizabeth in the style of Ferenc József Falconer.

History 
Above its main entrance is a Latin inscription (CREATORI 1705 CREATURA) announcing 1705 as the year the parish was founded. 

The current building was erected between 1746 and 1766 by  and . 

The main altar was designed by Kristóf Hickisch and inaugurated in 1799. The bell tower, originally erected in the center of the main façade, had to be demolished in 1765 due to a structural defect, and the tower to the south side was replaced.
